description: Application view model for user areas data (not stored as a database table), linked to area, users.
business_purpose: Used to track and report user areas records for the Branch & Geography area.
record_granularity: One object represents one user area result row.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Unique identifier of the user area.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: Reference to the users linked to this user area.

columns.name: areaId
columns.description: Reference to the area linked to this user area.

relationships.description: Each user area references one users (user).
Each user area references one area (area).

business_rules: Join to Area, Users through the foreign key columns to resolve names.
UserAreas is an application view model or report DTO populated in code, not a table stored in the database.

query_notes: Do not generate SQL against UserAreas: no table or view with this name exists in the connected database.
Use COUNT(DISTINCT id) when counting user area records; joins can duplicate rows.
To resolve names, join on: userId = Users.Id; areaId = Area.id.
Populated in application code (for example from a stored procedure or joined query); query the underlying tables instead.
